Although obesity prevalence continues to increase globally, emerging epidemiological data suggests that overall obesity rates may be reaching a plateau in some high-income countries. However, this apparent stabilization masks important disparities. Obesity prevalence continues to rise among certain ethnic minority populations, socioeconomically disadvantaged groups, children and adolescents and individuals with limited access to healthcare, healthy foods and opportunities for physical activity.
